title: Perkin Warbeck, York’s false scion, in breeches of silk of whiterose ivory, wonder of a day
html_source: Perkin Warbeck. Second pretender to the Throne of the first Tudor King Henry VII (Lambert Simnel was the first). He was used in a plot to usurp the throne by the Yorkist enemies of the dinasty. He was dressed in silk to impersonate Richard, Duke of York, who was presumed dead in the Tower of London. The heraldic symbol of the House of York was the white rose.
